title: Captured German nuclear scientists wiretapped in an English country house

tellings.quote: program. What's interesting about him is he and all the people on his nuclear program were captured like you said and they were put I believe in the English countryside and they the whole house was wiretapped

plain: In 1945 the physicist Werner Heisenberg and the people on Germany's nuclear program were captured and held in a country house in the English countryside where every room was wiretapped, so their private talk was recorded. Michels tells this himself, from memory ("I believe"), in a conversation with the philosopher Jason Jorjani about a Nazi UFO program. He points to the wiretap transcripts as a record of what the scientists actually knew and said among themselves.
